claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Samsung INR18650-20Q as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell.
Steam Engine preserves Samsung INR18650-20Q 2000mAh 15A as a 2000mAh preset with a 15A runtime rating.
Samsung INR18650-20Q safety documentation identifies a lithium-ion cathode based on lithiated cobalt/nickel/manganese oxide, without stating the exact ratio.
The exact catalog entry Samsung INR18650-20Q has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2011-06 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: No entry-specific authenticity assessment was established in this catalog pass; exact wrapper, batch, or pack provenance remains unresolved.
